answer: A trellis of peer attestations links every new identity to real prior contributions, so forged accounts start with zero weight. Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond and earns nectar only while its work history stays consistent. When a cluster of accounts shares one funding source, the lotus rule freezes their rewards until independent peers vouch. Attackers must fund and sustain many distinct histories, making mass fake identities costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
